questions.stem: What is the main difference between how phagocytes and lymphocytes defend the body?

options.text: Phagocytes form blood clots; lymphocytes repair damaged tissue
Phagocytes engulf and digest pathogens; lymphocytes produce antibodies
Phagocytes produce antibodies; lymphocytes engulf pathogens
Phagocytes carry oxygen; lymphocytes transport nutrients

questions.explanation: Phagocytes are white blood cells that engulf and digest pathogens (phagocytosis), while lymphocytes produce specific antibodies that target and neutralise particular pathogens.
